name: veterinary_clinic_system_008_vaccination_compliance_report
instruction: Produce the vaccination compliance report the practice manager reviews. Create collection veterinary_clinic_system_ops_reports with exactly one row per vaccine_type present in the data (rabies, DHPP, FVRCP, bordetella), each row: {report: 'vaccination_compliance', batch_code: <episode batch code>, vaccine_type, total: <count of vaccination rows of that type>, overdue: <count with due_date strictly before episode date>, compliance_pct: <round(100*(total-overdue)/total, 1) as a number>}. Rows may be in any order. Also create one row {report: 'vaccination_compliance', batch_code, vaccine_type: 'ALL', total: <all rows>, overdue: <all overdue>, compliance_pct: <same formula over ALL>}. No other rows may exist in the collection.

success_criteria.summary: Fetch vaccinations; compute per-type totals/overdue vs episode_date; assert 5 rows exist, each with exact total/overdue and compliance_pct within 0.05 (rounding tolerance) and batch_code == live nonce; assert no extra rows (exact count 5).

checks.expect: Fetch vaccinations; compute per-type totals/overdue vs episode_date; assert 5 rows exist, each with exact total/overdue and compliance_pct within 0.05 (rounding tolerance) and batch_code == live nonce

domain_searches.query: AAHA canine vaccination guidelines rabies DHPP bordetella booster interval adult dog
top_results: 2022 AAHA Core and Noncore Vaccines for Dogs (Table 2)

uniqueness_searches.query: vaccination compliance report percentage by vaccine type rabies DHPP FVRCP veterinary benchmark task
top_results: How Many Patients Are Missing Preventive Care You Recommend? (PDF)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Grouped aggregation with percentage rounding tolerance + exact-row-count anti-stuffing; agents often miss the ALL rollup or mis-round.
